caveats: Six of the ten records came from stale directory data and could not be confirmed as operating: two are gone (Karen's Consignment - Google 'Permanently closed'; J & L Toys - listed address is now a Walmart Supercenter) and four have no live listing at all (Hope & Dawn, Universal Comics & Hobbies, East Brunswick Flower Studio, Rudy's Florist).
No business in this batch has a working website, so 'website review' entries are mostly no-site findings rather than critiques of existing pages.
Google Maps' embedded view hid review counts for several places (Art Framing, Karen's), so those ratings are shown without counts.
Ace World Wide was excluded as a national branch and its site was reviewed only shallowly.
data_gaps: Certified Appliance Repair East Brunswick: ownership and legal identity unverifiable; the Google listing has no address and a different phone from the Birdeye record, and near-identical sibling names point at one lead-gen domain (inference: shared operator or lead broker).

Brandywine Floral Design: brandywinefloraldesign.com returned HTTP 456 with a blank shell on both the home page and /robots.txt, so robots.txt, schema and mobile layout could not be assessed; no 2026 activity found and the newest review visible on WeddingWire is from 2020.
Brandywine: the owner's name (Claus) comes from client reviews, not from an owned page.
Art Framing: Google review count did not render in the limited view; the owner name (Bob) comes from review text, not from the business.
The Knot pages returned 403 or HTTP2 errors to both fetch and browser, so Knot-side pricing and phone details could not be verified directly.
Hope & Dawn Boutique: no closure record found in press or registries; marked not found solely on absence from Google Maps and stale listings.
No phone calls or form submissions were made, so hours and current availability were not verified directly with any business.
